gbm_population_evidence.quote: Histopathologically proven diagnosis of glioblastoma, OR molecular diagnosis of glioblastoma per Consortium to Inform Molecular and Practical Approaches to Central Nervous System Tumor Taxonomy (c-IMPACT-NOW) criteria

candidate_evidence.quote: Testing the Addition of the Immune Therapy Drugs, Tocilizumab and Atezolizumab, to Radiation Therapy for Recurrent Glioblastoma

To determine the efficacy of the combination of tocilizumab (anti-IL6R), atezolizumab (anti-PD-L1), and FSRT in recurrent glioblastoma (GBM), as measured by the objective radiographic response rate (ORR).

treatment_setting_evidence.quote: Tumor that is in first recurrence following prior first-line radiation therapy (prior dose \>= 40 Gy)

target_engagement_planned_evidence.quote: The primary integrated correlative study is to determine the impact of anti-IL6 therapy on the GBM tumor microenvironment, and the systemic immune milieu, specifically with regard to the effect on tumor-associated macrophages, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and peripheral blood immune cells.
To evaluate the pharmacodynamic impact of the combination of tocilizumab (anti-IL6R), atezolizumab (anti-PD-L1), and FSRT on peripheral blood immune cell populations.

role_evidence.quote: Patients receive atezolizumab IV followed by tocilizumab 8 mg/kg IV on Day 1.

Therapy with fractionated stereotactic radiotherapy in combination with tocilizumab may suppress the inhibitory effect of immune cells surrounding the tumor and consequently allow an immunotherapy treatment by atezolizumab to activate the immune response against the tumor.

agents.drug_class_hint: anti-IL-6 receptor monoclonal antibody (approved for rheumatoid arthritis/CRS)
agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: binds IL-6 receptor; with FSRT may suppress the inhibitory effect of immune cells surrounding the tumour to allow atezolizumab-driven antitumour immune response
arms: Surgical Cohort: Arm A - Neoadjuvant Tocilizumab+Atezolizumab

role_evidence.quote: Immunotherapy with monoclonal antibodies, such as atezolizumab, may help the body's immune system attack the cancer, and may interfere with the ability of tumor cells to grow and spread.
Patients receive atezolizumab IV alone on Day 1 prior to FSRT and surgery.

agents.stated_antitumour_mechanism: anti-PD-L1; may help the body's immune system attack the cancer
arms: Surgical Cohort: Arm A - Neoadjuvant Tocilizumab+Atezolizumab
Surgical Cohort: Arm B - Neoadjuvant Atezolizumab Alone

source_quote.quote: Known somatic tumor mutation in IDH1 or IDH2 gene. If not previously completed, sequencing of the IDH1 and IDH2 genes is not required to determine trial eligibility

source_quote.quote: this requires presence of amplification of EGFR, whole chromosome 7 gain AND whole chromosome 10 loss, or TERT promoter mutation
Tumor O-6-methylguanine-deoxyribonucleic acid (DNA) methyltransferase (MGMT) methylation status must be available from any prior GBM tumor specimen

source_quote.quote: The primary integrated correlative study is to determine the impact of anti-IL6 therapy on the GBM tumor microenvironment, and the systemic immune milieu, specifically with regard to the effect on tumor-associated macrophages, tumor-infiltrating lymphocytes, and peripheral blood immune cells.

coder_notes: Tocilizumab and atezolizumab both investigational (experimental_combination in Arms 3/4/A); tocilizumab is given alone with FSRT in dose levels 1-2 and atezolizumab alone in surgical Arm B, so roles vary by arm. Arm A intervention list omits atezolizumab but its description says patients receive it; included. Surgical Arm B (atezolizumab alone, EXPERIMENTAL label) serves as the 'without tocilizumab' comparator for the window-of-opportunity question, hence control_arm_from_other_arms yes. MGMT status must only be available (no status requirement), so not coded as eligibility. EGFR amplification/+7-10/TERT appear only as a diagnostic route for molecular GBM, not a selection marker; not candidate-matched. Mismatch-repair item is germline and was not recorded. Pharmacodynamic tissue sampling is linked to tocilizumab (anti-IL6).
